svg.aria-label: Ensembyte hero: a lead coding agent plans a task, eight Hydra heads fan out into parallel git worktrees, diffs flip from red to green, results auto-merge through a progress gate, and the v1.1.18 build ships with pixel confetti while a HYDRA GRID HUD tracks heads, worktrees and tokens.
